summary: Local Date construction/setter operations resolve DST gaps/overlaps with ECMAScript compatible disambiguation rather than arbitrary platform defaults.

target.notes: This helper contract is shared by multi-argument construction and local setters.

semantics.gap: advance local time forward by the gap duration

caveats: Do not assume .NET TimeZoneInfo invalid/ambiguous-time default choices automatically match ECMAScript.

tests.name: spring-forward gap
tests.expected_behavior: prints 3 because 02:30 is in the DST gap and is advanced by one hour

tests.name: fall-back overlap chooses earlier instant
tests.expected_behavior: prints 240 (EDT), selecting the earlier occurrence rather than the later EST occurrence
